baseline.description: Training-only inverse-square Euclidean distance weighted mean of transformed targets at the nearest50 training samples, ties by sampleId lexicographic order. Normalize weights by nearest distance. Exact zero-distance queries average every coincident training target.

candidate.description: One fixed candidate: class mean=(class sum+20*global training mean)/(class count+20); subtract that class mean from each training target; IDW50 its residuals and add the query class mean (global fallback). Clip prediction at log1p(0.5). Same zero-distance/tie rule. No hyperparameter search.

cohort.definition: All 2578 rows of the pinned six-field national-atlas metadata census, without target-based selection. The distinct pH cohort is excluded by source-table choice, not values. All rows remain in the inventory, including buffer exclusions.
cohort.ids: Unmodified integer prov_id represented as decimal text; metadataOrdinal is census order, not original source row number.
cohort.metadataFailures: Stop before allocation on unexpected schema, flags, duplicate sample IDs/coordinates, missing or nonfinite coordinates, altered metadata or context. No deduplication or nearest fallback.

deviationPolicy: No outcome-driven change, exposed audit reuse, seed/grid/buffer search or unchanged-download learning claim. Record any failure against this exact design. Any future scientifically justified amendment must retain the original and exposure history; it cannot reopen an already reserved or consumed source.

evaluation.gate: Candidate must improve RMSE by >=2% on validation AND audit, with 95% bootstrap lower relative-improvement bound >0. Undefined baseline improvement or interval is inconclusive. Otherwise retain baseline. Audit is still evaluated once if validation fails, with no candidate change.
evaluation.refit: No validation refit or retraining before audit. Freeze training models and all validation/audit predictions before target scoring. No automatic promotion.
evaluation.uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-audit-group bootstrap replicates with replacement, NumPy2.5.3 PCG64 seed20261025, sorted group keys, same sampled groups for both models; sample-weighted SSE within each draw. Linear 2.5/97.5 percentiles of 1-sqrt(candidateSSE/baselineSSE). Any zero-baseline draw makes the interval inconclusive; no redraw.

execution: Metadata readiness and synthetic numerical tests only initially. Before real fitting or target decoding, implement a source-specific, hash-bound auditor and reserve the entire atlas GPKG once in the append-only registry. Reconstruct source metadata and context, verify frozen membership/runtime/code/model artifacts, isolate training target reads, and durably consume the audit before any held-out target access. This document alone cannot enforce those conditions.

exposureAtLocalCommitment.knownMetadata: Product/method definitions, published counts, collection-year range, CRS, six-field metadata locations, and unique-interior geological context coverage were inspected before this commitment.
exposureAtLocalCommitment.nonTargetExposure: Method-document context for Ag/Au/Pd/Pt/Re/Rh/Ta/Te censoring and an incidental web snippet containing example chromium percentile scale were seen. No Cu element map or target distribution was opened.
exposureAtLocalCommitment.timing: Local timestamps are self-reported. Later registry/publication timestamps cannot establish external blinding or historical preregistration.

nextStep: Implement and verify the source-specific auditor, then freeze and bind the unchanged executable plan before real target access. Geographic support has passed; source admission, fitted models and independent evaluation remain pending.

permissions.assay: SGU product documentation and general geodata terms explicitly CC0 1.0.
permissions.geology: SGU bedrock1:1million product documentation explicitly CC0 1.0.
permissions.publicScope: Reviewed method, aggregate metadata support, source links and hashes only in this increment. No assay values, memberships, private fields or internal paths.

predictors: Exact categorical published brg lithology code, represented as text; only unique interior matches. Unknown999, null or unseen classes use the global mean. No numeric ordering of lithologies.
projection: Reviewed method, aggregate metadata counts, source links and fingerprints only. Individual memberships, sample IDs, assay cells and private paths are excluded.
provenance: National atlas systematic nominal12.5km design is road-access biased; collection1983â€“2012 is not analysis date. Archived material and additional153 QC standards lack resolved parent/batch lineage.
Till <63 micrometres, 2g aqua-regia partial extraction, ICP-SFMS: not total ore concentration. Nominal ~0.8m C-horizon depth is not a per-row measured depth.

Current map integrates1994/2001 compilations, mapping available by2009, printed2012 and minor2016 corrections. Retained2024 package is not authenticated pre-assay bytes. Map lineage does not prove independence from SGU geochemistry.
1:1million generalization and glacial transport limit attribution of till chemistry to mapped local bedrock. Boundary distance, collection year, pH and other elemental values are not predictors.
scope: Conditional geographic prediction of a reported, floor-capped partial-extraction copper signal in Swedish national-atlas till, given the current SGU bedrock map. This is neither discovery evidence, an ore/resource estimate, nor a historical hindcast. Geological-map independence from historical geochemistry is unestablished.

softwareVerification.meaning: Synthetic numerical and metadata contract tests; no model improvement or real audit evidence.

split.assignment: group=floor(easting/50000):floor(northing/50000). SHA256 UTF8(salt+|+group), first eight hex digits as unsigned integer mod100: <60 train, <80 validation, otherwise audit. Group keys sorted for reporting only.
split.bufferRule: Using original assignments: remove train rows within strictly <12500m Euclidean distance of any original validation or audit row; remove validation rows within strictly <12500m of any original audit row. Retain audit rows. Original validation rows remain exclusion references even if themselves excluded. Equality is retained.
split.failure: Preserve failed membership and stop if any retained partition misses either minimum. Never resplit or relax gates.
split.rationale: 50km groups span four nominal 12.5km sampling spacings and regional support under a generalized 1:1million map. A 12.5km buffer enforces one nominal sampling spacing between retained partitions. Neither establishes full spatial or QC independence; no empirical variogram was consulted.
split.supportPlanning: After this commitment, count occupied fixed 50km groups before allocation. Use the existing exact multinomial support planner with weights60/20/20 and minima8/8/8. Its ideal independent allocation probability is planning information, not a power calculation, hash independence proof, buffer-aware probability or actual readiness. Do not search seeds, grids or buffers regardless of result.

supportPlanning.assumption: Each not-yet-allocated group is independently assigned with probabilities proportional to the supplied integer weights. This is a planning model, not measured randomness or geological independence.
supportPlanning.limitations: Ideal independent group allocation only; not a power calculation or buffer-aware probability. The fixed SHA256 assignment is deterministic; its independence and modulo bias are not modeled. No alternative geography or salt was searched.

target.failure: Reject the entire run on any null, nonnumeric (including strings and booleans), nonfinite, negative or >1000000 ppm target in the fixed cohort. No silent row removal, imputation, sentinel conversion or assay-driven cohort change. An error in a held-out target consumes that audit if access has started.
target.meaning: The documented Cu detection limit motivates a floor-capped reported signal; no row censor flags or latent uncensored concentrations are inferred. Equality to the limit is not evidence of censoring.

timing: The local design timestamp precedes the support calculation and single allocation. The wrapper includes later metadata readiness results. Times are self-reported; later registry/publication do not prove external blinding or historical preregistration.
title: Swedish atlas copper: fixed geographic support passes
